text_block_list.text:
On the way back from having lunch with 
Rice Shower after some training on our day 
off...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look, Big Brother. It says "Apple Fair."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look, Big Sister. It says "Apple Fair."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Apple jelly, apple tart... Wow, they all 
look so delicious...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I love them. I have precious 
memories connected to apples, after 
all..."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You know, when Rice was little, Rice got 
lost at a festival...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They found me right away, but I just 
couldn't stop crying...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Back then, my mother bought me a candied 
apple. And when I ate it...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It was so sweet, and I was so happy, and 
warm... My tears just stopped right away.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. That's why Rice loves apples... 
Eating them fills me with such a gentle 
feeling...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
*Yawn*... Smells so good. Just thinking 
about it makes me hungry...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but maybe now isn't the best 
time...? We did just finish eating 
lunch...
choice_data_list: Let's come back again when we're hungry.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah. You're right, we just ate after 
all...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then next time, let's go together after 
training is over, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because an apple eaten on an empty 
stomach... is bound to be so, so 
delicious...

With the sweet aroma of the Apple Fair at 
our backs, we took our leave.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Separate stomach...? Can I really eat 
it?"
choice_data_list: Only as much as you can handle, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! Okay, an apple tart, and some 
jelly, and juice, and—

Afterward, Rice Shower ended up eating 
every single item on the "Apple Fair" 
menu...
